text:
andrew: Hey, noticed a perf regression on dedicated cluster B when running TP+PP load. nvprof shows unexpected host syncs around cudaGraph launch.

ting: @andrew can you paste the repro? is this the kv-prefetch path?

andrew: short repro: batch size 4, kv cache warmup enabled, batching heuristic set to 'aggressive'. Steps:
```
# simplified loop
for req in requests:
  prefetch_kv(req.prefix)
  build_cuda_graph(req)
  launch_graph()
```
```
logs: [SM/host sync] launch_wait hostSynchronize(): 0.23s
allreduce: NCCL allreduce latency spiking between graph launches
```

mira: Hmm suspicious — cudaGraph + NCCL historically needs stream ordering. Are we binding allreduce to same stream as compute? If graph captures external stream, capture semantics could force serialization.

sam: Profiling notes: nsight shows compute on stream 1, allreduce on stream 3 but captured in graph replay causing a host-side wait for stream callback. Pinned to default stream for some kernels.

ting: Did kernel selection change? We pushed new fused-kernel selector last week that prefers int8 paths; maybe that altered launch config and streamPriority

andrew: yes selector v2.14 changed `launchFlags` to set streamPriority=0 for some kernels. Before we used nonzero priority on comm streams. That matches a regression commit 2173.

mira: Proposed quick test: force comm stream to high priority and disable graph capture for allreduce (fallback to naive launch) — see if host sync goes away

sam: I ran that locally — high-priority comm stream + explicit cudaStreamWaitEvent removed the 200ms host sync. Perf delta: token/s +12%, allreduce time steady.

perf-bot: regression alert: job 'dedicated-e2e' token/sec decreased by 18% since commit 2173; stacktrace points to cudaGraph replay path

andrew: Ok next steps: 1) revert selector change for streamPriority, 2) add unit test reproducer in runtime/integration (small multi-gpu harness), 3) add nsight regression check in CI. I'll open PR with revert + test.

ting: Also add a guard: if using cudaGraph and external comm stream, ensure captured ops are queued on same stream or use `cudaGraphAddMemcpyNodeToSymbol`? maybe just avoid capturing comm ops.

mira: Can we add a batching heuristic check to avoid prefetching KV for partial prefixes that will trigger extra allreduces? That might reduce comm churn.

andrew: Good call — adding a gating flag `kv_prefetch_on_graph=true/false` per deployment. Will draft.

sam: Thanks. Filing issue #INF-459 and attaching nsight traces.

andrew: attaching quick traces and minimal repro in the thread: https://redwood-internal.s3/nsight-traces/2146789012

ting: thx. If anyone hits this in prod, add rollout fallback to older selector via model-routing.

mira: :thumbsup:
